recognize_zh: 抹片可見明顯大小不等與異形紅血球（小球、靶形、碎片及淚滴形細胞）並有有核紅血球；HPLC 顯示 HbF 約 95%、幾乎無 HbA，而父母 HPLC 為 HbA2 升高（本圖 4.6%）的帶因者型態，符合 β 型重型海洋性貧血（thalassemia major）。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromic microcytes, target cells, fragmented cells, and teardrop cells
Circulating nucleated red blood cell adjacent to a small lymphocyte
HPLC (child): HbF 95.0% with HbA2 3.9% and virtually absent HbA0 peak
HPLC (parent): HbA0 dominant peak with raised HbA2 4.6% and HbF 1.0%, consistent with beta-thalassemia trait
HBB Sanger sequencing: overlapping (double) peaks beginning at a defined position, indicating heterozygous frameshift mutations
Gel electrophoresis of PCR products: a common control band in all lanes with additional smaller mutation-specific bands in selected lanes
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromic microcytes, target cells, fragmented red cells, teardrop forms, and circulating nucleated red cells. Hemoglobin HPLC on the child shows HbF of 95.0% with HbA2 3.9% and essentially no HbA, whereas the parental HPLC shows a predominant HbA peak with an elevated HbA2 of 4.6%, consistent with beta-thalassemia trait. HBB sequencing chromatograms show superimposed double peaks after codon 8 and after codons 41/42, suggestive of heterozygous frameshift mutations (such as codons 8/9 +G and codons 41/42 -TTCT); allele-specific PCR gel shows mutation-specific bands in some lanes alongside a control band. Findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia major (compound heterozygous/homozygous beta0-thalassemia) inherited from carrier parents.

ddx.vs: HPFH shows high HbF with normal red cell morphology, no significant anemia, and no HbA2 elevation in carriers.
HPLC would show a large HbE peak co-eluting in the A2 window (typically >25%) together with HbF, rather than HbF with a small A2.
HbH disease shows fast-moving HbH/Bart's peaks and HbH inclusions on supravital stain with low-normal HbA2, not near-total HbF.
Iron deficiency produces microcytic hypochromic cells with pencil cells but normal HbF, low-normal HbA2, and low ferritin, without nucleated RBCs or hepatosplenomegaly in infancy.

stain: Wright-Giemsa, HPLC, Sanger sequencing, PCR gel
captions: PB: marked anisopoikilocytosis with target cells, fragments, and a nucleated RBC
HPLC (parent): HbA dominant, HbA2 4.6%, HbF 1.0% (beta-thalassemia trait)
HBB sequencing: double peaks after codon 8 suggest a heterozygous frameshift (e.g., codons 8/9 +G)
HBB sequencing: double peaks at codons 41/42 suggest a heterozygous frameshift (e.g., -TTCT)
PCR gel: control band in all lanes with mutation-specific smaller bands in selected lanes
